SELECT 
    i_item_id, 
    s_state, 
    GROUPING(s_state) AS g_state, 
    AVG(ss_quantity) AS agg1, 
    AVG(ss_list_price) AS agg2, 
    AVG(ss_coupon_amt) AS agg3, 
    AVG(ss_sales_price) AS agg4 
FROM 
    store_sales 
JOIN 
    (SELECT 
        cd_demo_sk 
     FROM 
        customer_demographics 
     WHERE 
        cd_gender = 'M' 
        AND cd_marital_status = 'W' 
        AND cd_education_status = 'Secondary') AS cd 
    ON store_sales.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk 
JOIN 
    date_dim 
    ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk 
    AND date_dim.d_year = 1999 
JOIN 
    (SELECT 
        s_store_sk, 
        s_state 
     FROM 
        store 
     WHERE 
        s_state = 'TN') AS s 
    ON store_sales.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk 
JOIN 
    item 
    ON store_sales.ss_item_sk = item.i_item_sk 
GROUP BY 
    ROLLUP (i_item_id, s_state) 
ORDER BY 
    i_item_id, 
    s_state 
LIMIT 100
